column4: ヨシフが怒っている、まだ人間共を押し切れないのか
column5: Joseph is angry; they still can't overwhelm the humans?

column4: えーい、根性のない部隊は後ろから矢をかけてやれ
column5: Hey! Shoot arrows at any troops without guts from behind!

column4: 死ぬ気で戦わせろ。兵隊などいくらでも補充が聞くからな
column5: Make them fight as if their lives depend on it. We have endless soldiers to replace them.

column4: ところでシルキィはどうした。
column5: By the way, what happened to Silky?

column4: はい、さきほど出撃されましたが・・それが・・
column5: Yes, she was dispatched earlier but... well...
It seems she is not on the battlefield.

column4: なんだと・・逃げたのか
まさか、そんな事は・・ホーネットを人質に取られこれまで
column5: No way, that can't be... she has been obedient until now since Hornet was held hostage.

column4: これまで言う事を聞いてきたのに今になって逃げるなど
column5: She has obeyed until now, but to flee now...

column4: とにかく、敵前逃亡だ、戻ってきたらきついお仕置きをしてやる。
column5: In any case, fleeing from the enemy-when she returns, she'll get a harsh punishment.

column4: 女として生まれてきた事、不死の魔人になった事、後悔させてやるわ
column5: I'll make her regret being born a woman and becoming an immortal Fiend.
